source: crates/apr-cli/src/commands/golden_output.rs::golden_test_cases, the same three cases given as USER MESSAGES rather than pre-rendered ChatML: each engine applies the chat template it reads from the GGUF, and that step is part of what is under test (#3672 is a template defect a pre-rendered prompt would hide). scripts/check_crux_inference_judge.sh refuses drift between the two lists.
chat: chat-arith-2turn is the chat verb's conversation: two USER turns, judged on the FINAL reply (12 needs the first turn's 4 carried over). Every reply is recorded. Prompts without a "verb" belong to run.
control: golden-2plus2 is the POSITIVE CONTROL (the cop's ruling on #3739): the smallest model answers it right on every engine, so a control cell that comes back ALL_WRONG declines the run as a broken harness rather than recording a model limitation.
